relocation_rerun.real_data_access: First eligible original validation feature-cache window only, fixed by the existing runner. No fresh-test access or new performance calculation.

scope: Completed post-hoc original-validation component development study. Independent aggregation/bootstrap arithmetic, full-training/checkpoint checks and freshly reexecuted physical offline parity; no fresh test or additional benchmark evaluation.

interpretation.mixing: Native h5 and h10 gains have favorable exploratory intervals with and without innovation bounding. This is the mixing package including gate, identity bias and extra active capacity.
interpretation.bounding: All four native-coordinate bounding comparisons include zero. Two secondary coarse-coordinate bounding-without-mixing comparisons favor bounding; no general accuracy advantage is established.
interpretation.interaction: All four reported interaction intervals include zero; this is inconclusive, not evidence of exact additivity or equivalence.
interpretation.scope: Controls were revealed before follow-up registration; original-validation-only findings, unadjusted intervals, no independent-test or SOTA claim.

paper_discussion_review.verdict: Numbers, effect directions, context/capacity caveats and exploratory scope agree with completed evidence.

figure_table_review: Pending updated completed-component display; separate follow-up receipt will bind those output hashes.
limitations: This audit reexecutes the frozen offline export runner rather than claiming a separately implemented neural forward function.
Python socket blocking and offline environment flags are application-level safeguards, not an OS network namespace.
The audited inference packages are local; this report does not assert publication of six additional public release assets.
Selected checkpoint errors are development results after seeing control outcomes.
Statistical intervals are not multiplicity adjusted.
